plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Zhone/DZS access device. It reports per-card CPU utilization and memory (total, free, utilization) from ZHONE-CARD-RESOURCES-MIB cardRuntimeTable, per-port inbound and outbound traffic rate, and system uptime (enterprise PEN 5504). Fan and power supply status are not collected.
name: Access

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each card of the Zhone/DZS access device in percent (ZHONE-CARD-RESOURCES-MIB cardProcessorUsage), one series per shelf.slot.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Physical memory of each card of the Zhone/DZS access device (ZHONE-CARD-RESOURCES-MIB cardTotalMem, reported in KB and converted to bytes at collection).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Unallocated physical memory of each card of the Zhone/DZS access device (ZHONE-CARD-RESOURCES-MIB cardAvailMem, reported in KB and converted to bytes at collection).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.query: (sum(device_memory_total{instance_type='access', __$labels__}) by (instance_id, index) - sum(device_memory_free{instance_type='access', __$labels__}) by (instance_id, index)) / sum(device_memory_total{instance_type='access', __$labels__}) by (instance_id, index) * 100
metrics.description: Memory utilization of each card of the Zhone/DZS access device, computed as (cardTotalMem - cardAvailMem) / cardTotalMem * 100.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
